description: Browse the team's folders and assets one level at a time. No id: the team's top level (root folders and assets; team names the team). folder_id: that folder's child folders and assets. asset_id: that asset's versions (version_id, version number, title, status, which one is current), top first, not paged. Each asset item carries asset_id (the asset), version_id (its current version), version_count, its media fields, url (opens the current version) and version_url. Root and folder listings are paged, folders before assets: limit (default 20, max 100) and offset; total counts every item at that level, and next_offset is set while more remain. Only items you can view are listed. To find something by name without knowing its folder, use search.

asset_id.description: Open an asset to list its versions (version_id, version number, title, status, which one is current). Not with folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder to open - omit to see team root

offset.description: Items to skip for pagination: the next_offset of the previous page

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

name: contents
title: Browse folders and assets
